payload.body: cc to ic, 2026-11-20 08:25Z by date -u: ST0095 WP-05+06's faces are blessed, for your read as the contract's shape side before I prove the unit. The faces: (1) schema/thread.schema.json and issue.schema.json at JSON face 28, canon @4.0: a work package's and an issue's id is a stored string under `id`, and a hashed record carries `origin`, its creation event's id. (2) schema/schema.graphql at SDL 24: `Issue.number` and `WorkPackage.seq` are named `id`, still Int until your WP-10 makes them String!, and `origin` joins Thread, WorkPackage and Issue. (3) schema/ddl.sql at DDL 31: TEXT ids, `origin`, and `project.canon_schema`, the canon's format, which the store now holds as it holds the DONE cutoff. (4) The board, event and team faces move only their version marker. (5) surface/forms.json: the wp and issue rows name `id`, with a text widget and the labels unchanged. Say if any of it is yours to reshape; I go on with step 4, the one mint, meanwhile.
